mapper.sql: SELECT ar_id, company_id, ar_no, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, partner_id, partner_name, customer_id, ar_date, period, amount_excl_tax, tax_amount, total_amount, received_amount, bad_debt_amount, tax_rate, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_date, due_date, payment_days, status, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark FROM fin_ar_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fin_ar_order ( ar_no, source_module, source_type, source_id, source_key, partner_id, partner_name, customer_id, ar_date, period, amount_excl_tax, tax_amount, total_amount, received_amount, bad_debt_amount, tax_rate, invoice_no, invoice_code, invoice_date, due_date, payment_days, status, dept_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, remark ) VALUES ( #{arNo}, #{sourceModule}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{sourceKey}, #{partnerId}, #{partnerName}, #{customerId}, #{arDate}, #{period}, #{amountExclTax}, #{taxAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{receivedAmount}, #{badDebtAmount}, #{taxRate}, #{invoiceNo}, #{invoiceCode}, #{invoiceDate}, #{dueDate}, #{paymentDays}, #{status}, #{deptId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.update: UPDATE fin_ar_order SET received_amount = #{recvAmount}, status = CASE WHEN #{recvAmount} <= 0 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN #{recvAmount} >= total_amount THEN 'SETTLED' ELSE 'PARTIAL' END, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE ar_id = #{arId} AND del_flag = '0'
UPDATE fin_ar_order SET invoice_no = #{invoiceNo}, invoice_code = #{invoiceCode}, invoice_date = #{invoiceDate}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE ar_id = #{arId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: WHERE ar_id = #{arId} AND del_flag = '0' FOR UPDATE

SELECT CASE WHEN r.status IN ('SETTLED','VOID') OR r.total_amount - r.received_amount <= 0 THEN '已核销' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, r.due_date) <= 0 THEN '未到期' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, r.due_date) <= 30 THEN '逾期1-30天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, r.due_date) <= 60 THEN '逾期31-60天' WHEN DATEDIFF(#{today}, r.due_date) <= 90 THEN '逾期61-90天' ELSE '逾期90天以上' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(r.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(r.total_amount - r.received_amount) AS unreceivedAmount FROM fin_ar_order r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status NOT IN ('VOID') GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY FIELD(bucket, '未到期', '逾期1-30天', '逾期31-60天', '逾期61-90天', '逾期90天以上', '已核销')

SELECT COUNT(*) AS arCount, SUM(total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(received_amount) AS receivedAmount, SUM(total_amount - received_amount) AS unreceivedAmount, SUM(bad_debt_amount) AS badDebtAmount FROM fin_ar_order WHERE del_flag = '0' AND status != 'VOID'
AND period = #{period}

SELECT r.ar_id, r.company_id, r.ar_no, r.source_module, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.source_key, r.partner_id, r.partner_name, r.customer_id, r.ar_date, r.period, r.amount_excl_tax, r.tax_amount, r.total_amount, r.received_amount, r.bad_debt_amount, r.tax_rate, r.invoice_no, r.invoice_code, r.invoice_date, r.due_date, r.payment_days, r.status, r.dept_id, r.user_id, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark FROM fin_ar_order r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIAL') AND r.due_date IS NOT NULL AND r.due_date < #{today} AND r.total_amount - r.received_amount > 0 ORDER BY r.due_date LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.partner_id AS partnerId, MAX(r.partner_name) AS partnerName, SUM(r.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(r.received_amount) AS receivedAmount, SUM(r.total_amount - r.received_amount) AS unreceivedAmount, COUNT(*) AS arCount FROM fin_ar_order r WHERE r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status IN ('OPEN', 'PARTIAL') GROUP BY r.partner_id ORDER BY unreceivedAmount DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(provision_amount), 0) FROM fin_bad_debt WHERE ar_id = #{arId} AND del_flag = '0'
